display.purpose: The homepage headline only: unpressed keys on the first line, the answer on the second. French min(100px, 6.9vw); under 650px min(15vw, 64px) at -0.04em.

headline.purpose: The h1 of Read pages (privacy, support).

title.purpose: Section h2s on the homepage; 26px (24px mobile) inside Read-page articles.

statement.purpose: Short declarative lines of the 'never' list, each above a muted paragraph.

subtitle.purpose: h3s and the contact card's heading.

lead.purpose: Moss Grey paragraph under a headline or section title, max 65ch; 18px under 650px.

body.purpose: All reading text; 62ch in descriptive lists, 720px measure on Read pages.

label.purpose: Buttons, the switch, the text button, the live count.

meta.purpose: Captions, store status, update date, policy index, readout status. Footer runs 13px/1.65; readout details 12.5px.

data.purpose: The register, in tabular numerals; column heads 700 at 13px.

shadows.name: drawn-outline
shadows.purpose: The only box-shadow in the system: an ink outline on the secondary button and the switch track. A line, not elevation; the site casts no shadows.

motion.name: wash
motion.purpose: The one motion grammar: a status changes in place (new readout entries, register rows turning). Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: The single easing curve, shared by the wash and the switch thumb.

motion.name: switch-thumb
motion.purpose: The switch knob slides 30px between off and on; the only movement besides the wash. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: switch-colour
motion.purpose: Track and thumb colour change on the switch. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: register-stagger
motion.purpose: Delay between register rows that enter view together (IntersectionObserver threshold 0.9).

motion.name: readout-settle
motion.purpose: After the last change arrives, the readout's status sentence is rewritten to summarise what Tacet did.

motion.name: anchor-scroll
motion.purpose: In-page anchors, inherited from the family. Auto under reduced motion.

narrative.overview:
A reader's page in paper and ink. Whatever a site demands of the reader shows up as a key nobody presses: a pale, dashed outline at display size, drawn but inert. Tacet's own voice speaks only from ink panels with lime type, and one lime highlighter marks the answer. Everything else is quiet: warm off-white paper, olive-black ink, hairline rules, generous 17px/1.7 reading text, no shadows, no imagery beyond the mark.

The world is inherited, not invented. It belongs to the sg-x family (the user's sibling extension, sg-x/docs/styles.css), chosen explicitly as "same family as sg-x". The shared family layer is identical value for value: paper, ink, muted, line, green, lime, tint, the selection colour, the system UI stack, the 1120px content and 720px reading widths, the section rhythm, header, footer, links, buttons, Read-page layouts and disclosures. Tacet adds four tokens and the devices built on them: the unpressed key colours (text and dashed line), the ink-panel rule and muted tokens, the switch, the readout, the ruled register, the lime highlighter under the answer, and the wash motion. Tacet extends the family without retuning any of its values.

Two things sit in the repository but outside this world. The made-up newspaper inside the homepage demo (docs/demo/demo.css, en.html, fr.html) imitates a generic news site on purpose, with a white ground, Georgia serif, a drop-shadowed consent box and uppercase tracked datelines. It is a contained exception that lives only inside the demo frame. The extension's toolbar popup (src/popup/) predates this world and is not part of it.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground (#f6f5ef) everywhere; depth comes from tone (tint card, ink panel), never from shadow.
One type family at weights 400 to 750; display character comes from weight 750 and tracking down to -0.045em.
Hairline-ruled structure: sections, lists, the register and disclosures are separated by 1px rules, not boxes.
Unpressed keys: the site's demands rendered as dashed, inert outlines at display size.
Ink panels with lime type are where Tacet itself speaks.
One motion grammar: a status changes in place under a brief lime wash.
Every string exists in English and French; layouts are sized for the longer French.

rules.name: The Family Rule
rules.body: The family tokens are sg-x's, value for value. Tacet adds tokens next to them and never retunes one.

rules.name: The Lime Has Two Places Rule
rules.body: Lime is type and marks on ink, where Tacet speaks, and a highlighter underline on paper, once per page. It is never text on paper and never the fill of a button or card. Its only other appearance is the transient wash.

rules.name: The Unpressed Rule
rules.body: The two unpressed colours belong only to keys nobody presses. Faded Key Olive holds 3.2:1, so it never appears below display size.

rules.name: The Folded Question Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow, kicker or small label above a heading. When a section has a question to ask, the question goes into the heading itself, as the homepage folds "Accept all / Refuse" into its h1.

rules.name: The Ledger Figures Rule
rules.body: Every figure that changes or is compared uses tabular numerals. This covers register times, change counts and readout timings.

rules.name: The French Runs Longer Rule
rules.body: Sizes are set so the French fits rather than trimmed to the English. The French headline is smaller (min(100px, 6.9vw)), and below 480px French keys shrink to min(1em, 10.5vw) so "Tout accepter" stays one key while the answer keeps its size.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the site floats. If something needs more weight, it moves from paper to tint, or from tint to an ink panel.

rules.name: The One Motion Rule
rules.body: A status changes in place under a brief lime wash: the background goes from rgb(213 237 117 / 22%) to transparent over 900ms on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). New readout entries and turning register rows use it, and nothing else animates apart from the switch's own knob. Under prefers-reduced-motion the wash, the switch transitions and smooth anchor scrolling are all off, and the register shows its final state from the start.

dos: Do keep paper (#f6f5ef) as the only page ground, and give Tacet's own voice an ink (#20231d) panel with 12px corners and lime type.
Do divide sections with a 1px Pencil Hairline (#d5d8ca) and clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px) of space, not with background bands or boxes.
Do draw any question the site puts to the reader as unpressed keys (3px dashed #b9bdaa, 2px under 650px, text #868b73, 0.17em corners), only at display size.
Do mark at most one answer per page with the lime highlighter: an underline 0.3em thick at -0.2em offset, skip-ink off.
Do set every changing or compared figure in tabular numerals.
Do announce every demo change in the readout (role="status") and keep it reversible by the same switch.
Do change a status in place under the 900ms lime wash, and turn it off under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do write every string in English and French, and size headlines and keys for the French.
Do keep touch targets at 44px minimum and buttons and the switch at 48px.
Do focus with a 3px Olive Mark (#526600) outline at 4px offset; inside ink panels, lime.
donts: Don't put an eyebrow, kicker or small label above a heading; fold the question into the heading.
Don't make an unpressed key clickable, hoverable or focusable, and don't style a real control with a dashed outline.
Don't set lime as text on paper, or use it to fill buttons or cards.
Don't add other motion: no fades, slides, scroll reveals, parallax or animated counters.
Don't use drop shadows or gradients for depth; move from paper to tint to ink instead.
Don't retune a family token (paper, ink, muted, line, green, lime, tint); add a named token beside it instead.
Don't show site or consent-tool logos; their names stay plain text.
Don't carry the demo newspaper's styles (Georgia serif, white ground, shadowed box, uppercase tracked datelines) out of the demo frame.
